title: UnDoFloor - Go back to an earlier floor
description:
Go back to an earlier floor of your current run from the map screen.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
Open the map and click a node with a sky-blue outline. Each visited floor offers up to two restore points:
[list]
[*] [b]Redo this floor[/b] - the moment you entered the room; play it again.
[*] [b]Keep result, re-pick path[/b] - after the combat or event finished, before you chose the next node.
[/list]
Use the [b]Previous act / Next act[/b] buttons on the left edge of the map to browse earlier acts and rewind across acts. Rewinding never deletes later restore points: abandoned timelines stay marked and clickable, so you can jump forward into them again.

Restore points are saved to disk per run and survive quitting the game. Only floors saved after the mod is installed have restore points.

[h2]Steam Cloud[/h2]
When Steam is running, the current run's restore points also travel as one bundle file next to current_run.save (one fixed file per profile, overwritten on every save, so it never piles up in your cloud quota). Continue the run on another PC and its restore points are merged in. Local restore points stay the source of truth: a cloud problem is only logged and never affects rewinding.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer only.
[*] Restores go through the game's own save/load path; no live state is patched.
[*] Text follows the game's language setting (all 16 languages).
[*] Source and manual downloads: https://github.com/hseunghwan/StS2-UnDoFloor
[/list]

[h2]한국어[/h2]
지도 화면에서 현재 런의 이전 층으로 되돌아갑니다. 하늘색 테두리가 있는 노드를 클릭해 [b]방 진입 시점[/b] 또는 [b]방 완료 시점[/b]으로 복원하고, 지도 왼쪽의 이전/다음 막 버튼으로 이전 막까지 되돌아갈 수 있습니다. 되돌아가도 이후 시간선은 유지되며, 복원 지점은 런별로 디스크에 저장됩니다. Steam이 실행 중이면 현재 런의 복원 지점이 프로필당 고정 파일 하나로 Steam Cloud에도 저장되어(매 저장마다 덮어쓰므로 파일이 쌓이지 않음) 다른 PC에서 런을 이어할 때 병합됩니다. 싱글플레이 전용.
changeNote: 0.3.0 - Steam Cloud: the current run's restore points now follow you to another PC. One fixed bundle file per profile (overwritten on every save, never accumulates), merged into local restore points when you continue the run elsewhere; a bundle can never roll back newer local restore points. Local restore points remain the source of truth and keep working if the cloud fails.
